Today was fun... We should do this<n>again
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower suddenly stops as<n>we're walking
back from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I was just thinking that the<n>sunset is really
pretty!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look at how the sunlight reflects off<n>the river. It's
like its warmth is gently<n>spreading outward.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I kinda want to draw this<n>scenery!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... whenever I see such beautiful<n>scenery, I
always want to put my<n>feelings down on paper.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Although, I guess it makes more<n>sense to take a
photo.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But with a drawing, I can capture the<n>emotions it
makes me feel as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You can head back to campus<n>ahead of me.
I'm sure you'll get<n>bored if you stay...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You can head back to campus<n>ahead of me.
I'm sure you'll get<n>bored if you stay...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? It'll take some time, though...
choice_data_list: I want to see what you draw.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay... In that case, I'll draw my<n>heart out!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She draws a picture of the sunset in<n>soft colors. For
some reason, just<n>looking at it makes me want to
smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: G-great! I guess my feelings came<n>through...
choice_data_list: I want to see more of your drawings.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-then... could I show you more from<n>time to time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because it makes me feel kind of...<n>warm... hearing
you compliment my<n>drawings...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're gonna draw, Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're gonna draw, Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-then... you can borrow my pens...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I only have one sketchbook...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a stationary store nearby.<n>I'll go buy
one. Wait right here, Big<n>Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a stationary store nearby.<n>I'll go buy
one. Wait right here, Big<n>Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower prepares to go buy the<n>sketchbook,
looking particularly<n>pleased.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... I always draw by myself, so<n>I never
thought that...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Drawing together with someone could<n>be fun too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Especially if that someone is you.Hehe.

text_block_list.text:
After that, Rice Shower buys me a<n>sketchbook, and
